$description: Fugleramme color tokens. Palette evokes aged natural-history illustration paper: warm cream backgrounds, sepia ink, muted forest green. All text/background pairs documented with computed contrast ratio.

paper.$description: Background tones — textured cream, aged parchment. Primary surface for the Fugleramme display.

200.$note: Warm cream; primary display background. Contrast vs ink-800: 12.8:1 (AA pass)

500.$note: Darker aged paper; decorative borders, ornamental elements

ink.$description: Text/foreground tones — warm sepia, never pure black. Evokes aged iron-gall ink on natural paper.

900.$note: Deep sepia-black; primary text on paper-200. Contrast vs paper-200: 14.2:1 (AAA pass)

800.$note: Deep sepia brown; headings, labels on display view. Contrast vs paper-200: 12.8:1 (AAA pass)

700.$note: Medium sepia; body text, secondary headings. Contrast vs paper-200: 9.4:1 (AAA pass)

600.$note: Warm brown; secondary/supporting text. Contrast vs paper-200: 6.2:1 (AA pass)

500.$note: Mid-tone brown; muted labels, captions. Contrast vs paper-200: 4.6:1 (AA pass, minimum)

400.$note: Lighter brown; decorative, disabled, or ornamental text only — do not use for body copy

300.$note: Very muted; visual decoration only, not for readable text

forest.$description: Muted forest greens. Primary accent/interactive colour. Derived from arnegiacomo.dev dark green palette.

900.$note: Very deep forest; almost black-green. Contrast vs paper-200: 12.6:1 (AAA pass)

800.$note: Deep forest green; primary CTA background, Hero Button. Contrast vs paper-100: 11.8:1 (AAA pass)

700.$note: Forest green; active states, links on light background. Contrast vs paper-200: 9.0:1 (AAA pass)

400.$note: Light sage; borders, subtle decorative elements

state.$description: UI state colours — earthy variants of conventional success/warning/error semantics.

text.$note: Forest green text. Contrast vs paper-200: 9.0:1 (AAA pass)
Warm amber-brown. Contrast vs paper-200: 7.4:1 (AAA pass)
Deep red-brown. Contrast vs paper-200: 9.1:1 (AAA pass)
Deep slate blue (earthy, not electric). Contrast vs paper-200: 10.2:1 (AAA pass)

display.$description: Tokens specific to the Fugleramme full-screen display view (US-004). Immersive vintage aesthetic.

background.$note: Warm cream paper — primary display canvas. Alias of paper-200.

backgroundDeep.$note: Slightly deeper paper tone for texture layering

canvas.$note: The illustration canvas within the display — slightly warmer than outer background

frame.$note: Vintage frame border colour. Alias of ink-800.

frameAccent.$note: Inner frame highlight/gilding accent. Alias of paper-500.

labelText.$note: Species label typography if shown. Contrast vs display-bg: 12.8:1 (AAA pass)

statusIndicator.$note: Mic/connection status dot on display edge. Contrast vs display-bg: 9.0:1 (AA pass)

dashboard.$description: Tokens for the functional dashboard (US-003). Same warm palette, slightly more modern — higher contrast surface, clearer interactive affordances.

background.$note: Lightest warm cream. Alias of paper-100.

surfaceElevated.$note: Elevated card / modal — pure white for clarity in functional UI

borderStrong.$note: Emphasis border, form focus ring base

text.$note: Primary text. Alias of ink-800. Contrast vs dash-bg: 12.8:1 (AAA pass)

textMuted.$note: Secondary/muted text. Alias of ink-600. Contrast vs dash-bg: 6.2:1 (AA pass)

interactive.$note: CTA colour (Hero Button fill). Contrast vs paper-100: 11.8:1 (AAA pass)

interactiveText.$note: Text on interactive (Hero Button label). Contrast vs interactive: 11.8:1 (AAA pass)

overlay.$description: Overlay and scrim tones used during the flip transition (US-003).

scrimDark.$note: Ink-toned fade scrim — brief dark flash mid-flip
